card.text: Red dwarf 38 parsecs away that hosts the planet K2-18 b.

introduction.text: K2-18 is a red dwarf 38 parsecs away, about 0.44 of the Sun’s radius. Its planet K2-18 b circles it every 33 days.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of a measured spectrum of the star. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.

habitable-zone.title: Conservative and optimistic zones
habitable-zone.summary: Where a planet with enough air could keep liquid water, as calculated. Darker: conservative limits; lighter: optimistic.
